description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and a performance metric (likely retrieval or generation score) across four distinct data sources: Tutorials (blue circles, solid line), Library Documentation (red circles, solid line), GitHub files (green circles, solid line), and StackOverflow posts (yellow circles, solid line). The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” spans from 100 to 900 with major tick marks at 200, 400, 600, and 800, using a linear scale. The y-axis, unlabeled but numerically scaled from 10 to 40 with tick marks at 10, 20, 30, and 40, also uses a linear scale. The blue line (Tutorials) starts at approximately y=24 at x=100, rises steadily to y=42 at x=900. The red line (Library Documentation) begins at y=28, increases to y=44 at x=700, then slightly declines to y=43 at x=900. The green line (GitHub files) starts at y=29, rises to y=45 at x=700, and remains nearly flat at y=45 at x=900. The yellow line (StackOverflow posts) starts at y=34, peaks at y=37 at x=400, then declines to y=28 at x=900. All lines are connected with solid segments and marked with circular data points at each plotted token count.
